en: The image depicts a tranquil waterfront scene in black and white, featuring traditional wooden houses on stilts, a large docked steamship, smaller boats, and a sailing boat with two people. The architecture is characteristic of Scandinavian coastal towns, and the flag on the sailboat resembles the Swedish flag. There is a faint text on one of the buildings, but it is not fully legible.
